description: Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions. Ready to take on challenges. Hardcore reader and lover of the natural and programming languages.
foxbelDesc: Spotify-like Vue Single Page Application that works under a reverse proxy to play Deezer song previews, fully responsive.
portfolioDesc: Page I made to showcase all of my projects and skills. Developed in order to make myself known to the client.
aguinagaDesc: Front-end of a Headless CMS project made with React and Next for a vaccine lab. Fully implemented with Typescript.
everythingMoneyDesc: Financial platform migrated from React to Next.js, achieving 55% speed improvement and 80% faster initial loads. Features real-time stock data from Morningstar and TradingView, Stripe payments, community chat with sub-150ms latency, and Datadog monitoring.
truoraDesc: AWS infrastructure provisioning with Terraform. Built Lambda services in Go for ChatOps deployment pipelines, along with E2E and unit tests in a UNIX environment.
falabellaDesc: Serverless logistics platform for Falabella department stores built on Google Cloud. Managed product transportation workflows with cloud-native microservices and on-premise integrations.
zeiaDesc: IoT dashboard for real-time air quality monitoring. Integrated ML models to predict next-day conditions and automated email alerts when thresholds were exceeded.
pokemonDesc: Simple webpage that allows listing, searching, posting, editing and deleting pokemons that are fetched through an API.
